Authentication is not required to exploit this vulnerability. The specific flaw exists within the telnet service, which listens on TCP port 22 by default. title: Siemens Comfort Panel Telnet Service Missing Authentication Remote Code Execution Vulnerability
vulnerability_details: This vulnerability allows remote attackers to execute arbitrary code on affected installations of Siemens Comfort Panel. Authentication is not required to exploit this vulnerability. The specific flaw exists within the telnet service, which listens on TCP port 22 by default. The issue results from the lack of authentication prior to allowing remote connections. An attacker can leverage this vulnerability to execute code in the context of SYSTEM.
